head.text: The project runs from September 1 to November 27 in five stages: research, definition, identity design, visual language, and delivery. Constraints and a test list are stated once at the start. The marker is September 9, 2026, the date of this deck.

items.value: The inputs are prototemplate.com as the handoff site, the brand book, the questionnaire finalized August 11, and the test list.
The four reviews cover the territory, the identity direction, the system, and the handoff. GT selects one option at each and returns one consolidated feedback document within 48 hours.
